name: dry-backup
title: Back up to Dry
description: Copy this document's baskets and cards into a Dry space. Re-running updates the same items instead of duplicating them, so it is safe to run as often as you like.

config.label: Dry MCP token
config.help: Recommended. Sent as a Bearer token. Unlike the access key it isn't invalidated when you regenerate your profile key.

config.label: Dry access key
config.help: Alternative to the MCP token — your profile's API Access Key. Regenerating it in Dry invalidates the old one.

config.label: Dry space name
config.help: Where to back up. Defaults to 'Trellis backup — <document>'.
